text_en: You shouldn't scare us at a time like this!
The rest of us?_500_ You'll see...
Everything was going fine until a group of nasty spiders came hurtling towards us out of nowhere, dragging the others into the darkness of the cave.
I was going to help, but realised that my shoelaces were untied._300_ I dunno what this lazybones was doing, though.
I told you!_300_ I was watching over the provisions!_300_ You saw how hungry those bugs looked.
Oh, really?_300_ And since when have our boots had laces?
Never mind the details._300_ The important thing now is to come up with a rescue plan.
Yes! Will you help us?_100_ Perfect! We're going to check out the main room, just in case.
Th-_100_ Thank you._300_ Please, find them.
